name: explorer-name-collections
goal: A route word before a parameter keeps its letters unless it is an explorer collection: /projects/[projectId]/harness/[...path] is named Harness.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: screenOf cut any trailing s before a parameter: /projects/[projectId]/harness/[...path] was named Harnes for the desktop and hub pages. Expected Harness.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: vitest test/utils/explorer-name.test.ts on unrepaired source: 1 failed, 7 passed; expected 'Harnes' to be 'Harness'. /tmp/harness-explorer-name-red.log

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Only explorerCategories words are singularized before a parameter; other route words are kept. Manifest gains the derived dependency function.explorer-route.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same test file, sha 088872b4: 8 passed; five naming files 29 passed. Types, lint, format, audit, units check pass. /tmp/harness-explorer-name-green.log, -focused.log

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Independent 29 assertions passed. Browser inspection confirmed clean Harness titles and branch navigation. Types, lint and formatting passed at 697023c; full repository check passed at 5a36336.
